level.selection_rule: lowest LOO MAE (pp); fewer covariates within 0.25 pp

bridge.fit: national FIES 2021 -> 2023 (verified) with national SWS annual means

sensitivity_pre_window.note: Opposite signs: SWS 3-month hunger rose during the 2020-21 lockdown quarters while 12-month FIES fell between the 2019 and 2021 waves. The bridge is not supported across that shock.

holdout.target: CALABARZON FIES 2025 (FNRI 2025 Updating Survey via PIA; provisional secondary, no CI)
holdout.class_rule: HIGH = above the upper 95% limit of the 2023 survey estimate (significantly above the last measured level)

hfias_2015.what: 2015 FNRI HFIAS moderate+severe by province (verified; an input of the composite, so not independent)

enns_secondary.what: ENNS moderate-to-severe by province (RDP results matrix; secondary, unverified, instrument not stated, years differ by province); not used by the model

regional_quarterly_component.task: SWS hunger in Balance Luzon significantly above normal, next quarter (regional; walk-forward 2010-2026)
regional_quarterly_component.note: Regional measured hunger, the input of the bridge; not a provincial food-insecurity result.

Market and food prices.tested_as: M4 rice inflation; M6 poverty + rice inflation
Market and food prices.role: Secondary task: provincial food-price pressure forecast (FI10). Not a level predictor.

Climate and agricultural production.tested_as: not testable for the level: no region-level 2023 series on file for all 17 FIES regions
Climate and agricultural production.role: Context and drivers of the price task; shown as supporting indicators.

Employment and remittances.role: Supporting indicator. Remittances (E2) are national only and cannot be tested across regions.

News and NLP.tested_as: no region-level news series matched to the FIES regions
News and NLP.role: Food-stress intelligence shown beside the forecast; not a model input.

Regional hunger (SWS).role: Selected: moves the level between survey waves and drives the next-quarter forecast.

provincial_quarterly.status: NOT EVALUABLE: no quarterly or repeated provincial FIES measurement exists; scored prospectively from the register

objective_75.statement: The 75% target is met for classifying measured food-insecurity levels of held-out regions (17/17; 95% CI 0.82-1.00). It is not shown for provincial next-quarter forecasts, which no survey measures; those are registered and scored when the next FIES wave is published.
